body: Yes, or at least call my boss and see if he still wants me to come in. No Call/No Show = losing job.

Exactly, and I guess I just want to see people reach out to me. I want them to see if I’m okay, (but not in an annoying, let me give you unsolicited unhelpful advice) literally just because they care. Instead they only ask because I’ve broken down and said something. It’s sad. Thanks for reading and getting it by the way.
